input.summary: Insert a mutual aggregate liability cap based on 12 months of fees, with indemnification, confidentiality, gross negligence and wilful misconduct outside the cap.
input.comment: [Playbook] We have added a mutual aggregate liability cap set at the fees paid or payable by AbbVie in the twelve months preceding the claim, which is our fallback position; the Agreement currently contains no cap for either Party. Consistent with Section 11.5, each Party's indemnification obligations, breaches of Article 9 or Section 5.8, and its fraud, wilful misconduct or gross negligence sit outside the cap.

ops.text: 11.7 Limitation of Liability. Except for a Party's fraud, willful misconduct or gross negligence, a Party's breach of its obligations under Article 9 or Section 5.8, and a Party's indemnification obligations under this Article 11, each Party's total aggregate liability arising out of or relating to this Agreement shall not exceed the fees paid or payable by AbbVie under this Agreement in the twelve (12) months preceding the claim.
